entry.summary: 《一文了解以太坊 Pectra 升级：各项 EIPs 全解析》本文解析以太坊 Pectra 升级的关键内容：作为执行层（Prague）和共识层（Electra）协同的重大硬分叉，其包含 11 个 EIP，是历史上涉及 EIP 数量最多的升级之一。测试网升级历经波折后，主网定于 5 月 7 日 10:05 UTC 激活。核心改进包括：通过 EIP-7251、EIP-7002、EIP-6110 优化验证者质押机制，提升质押灵活性与资金效率；借助 EIP-7691、EIP-7623 提高 Blob 吞吐量，降低 L2 交易成本；利用 EIP-7702 实现 EOA 账户临时智能合约功能，改善用户体验；此外，EIP-7685、EIP-2537 等其他 EIP 分别在跨层请求处理、加密运算效率、历史区块哈希存储等方面进行优化，为账户抽象、Layer 2 扩展及网络性能提升奠定基础。阅读全文：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/DrARVuj2_RSliVcv2yTYqg

He was sufficiently disgusted by what he had done that it convinced him that trial by jury was unworkable in a multiethnic state like Singapore, since ethnic conflict would always prevent justice from being served. Black jurors are on the same level as the Malay jurors that Lee convinced all the way back in the 40s. entry.title: RT adam: Some food for thought in regards to what I see here basically every day when it comes to Bitcoin price action. Bitcoin has pretty unique char...
entry.summary: RT adam Some food for thought in regards to what I see here basically every day when it comes to Bitcoin price action. Bitcoin has pretty unique characteristic of doing nothing a lot of times and then trending extremely hard all of a sudden. Although Twitter can be an awesome resource for your trading, you can see people flip-flopping on every single hourly candle close during the day. As I believe most of you have an actual life and do not trade 1-minute charts, this can be very confusing and can mess up your bias as you try to position into bigger swing trades. Below you see a weekly OHLC of BTCUSD from 2021 till today, which consists of 224 trading weeks. From those, only 11 of them (4.91%) can be considered as trending weeks (above 2 standard deviations from the mean OHLC). Point here is that if you are trying to catch bigger swings in price, you are best to ignore most of the day-to-day noise you see online.
